title: Applicability of article.
bodyText: The provisions of this article shall govern the registration, reporting and examination of financial institution holding companies in this State.
bodyHtml:
ARTICLE 11.  FINANCIAL INSTITUTION HOLDING COMPANIES

 

     §412:11-100  Applicability of article.  The provisions of this article shall govern the registration, reporting and examination of financial institution holding companies in this State. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
